name: Prodigy (Background)
body:
You were born with an inherent understanding of some of the powers of the world around you.

Prerequisite(s): Caster level 1st

Benefit: Once per day, you may increase your caster level by 2 for all purposes relating to a single spell you cast. This does not increase the spell’s casting time. You may not exceed the normal maximum damage dice of the spell by means of this ability. This ability may only be used on whichever class you had at character creation.
